question: Should this owner-authored weekly-headroom feature merge after its exact-head test shards finish and its merge result is refreshed against current main?
rationale: Repository policy requires owner-authored pull requests to remain open for explicit maintainer judgment, and the feature changes persisted usage-history behavior despite having targeted regression coverage.

options.title: Merge after current-head confirmation
options.body: Confirm the pending exact-head jobs and refreshed merge result, then merge the reviewed feature as implemented.

options.title: Hold for additional upgrade review

recommendation.title: Merge after current-head confirmation
